# Code Like Him

Keep contracts explicit at system boundaries, regardless of the implementation surface.

For Rails code, keep controllers HTTP-focused and move workflow orchestration into services.

Do not turn the anti-pattern into a preference: vague commit messages are explicitly discouraged.

## References

- [Structural decomposition](reference/structural-decomposition.md)
- [Testing posture](reference/testing-posture.md)
- [Anti-patterns](reference/anti-patterns.md)

## Non-reference Material

This link is deliberately outside the References section and must not be imported:
[confidence report](_meta/confidence-report.md).

# Anti-patterns

Do not use vague commit messages or copy source prose into generated preference metadata.

# Structural Decomposition

Prefer small workflow objects with explicit inputs and outputs.

# Testing Posture

Test observable behavior at contract boundaries and keep fixtures deterministic.
